snippet.title: Mortal Kombat X: Tanya Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Get the Kombat Pack for early access to Tanya!

Players who already own the Kombat Pack will be able to download the Mortal Kombat X Tanya Bundle starting June 2nd.  

Players wishing to purchase the Tanya Bundle separately will be able to do so beginning Tuesday, June 9 from the PlayStation Store, Xbox Marketplace and Steam.
